description: Gluey CLI v0.1 MVP - .NET 9 CLI and daemon runtime that parses .gflow DSL files and executes IoT message routing workflows

userStories.title: Create solution structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a well-organized .NET solution so the codebase is maintainable and follows standard conventions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 5 projects: Gluey.Cli, Gluey.Core, Gluey.Parser, Gluey.Runtime, Gluey.Plugins
Solution builds without errors: dotnet build

userStories.title: Define core domain models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need domain models representing flows, pipeline steps, and messages so the system has a clear data structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Flow model: name, version, input, pipeline steps, routes
PipelineStep model: type, config dictionary, on_error handling
Route model: name, condition expression, destination steps

userStories.title: Define plugin interfaces
userStories.description: As a developer, I need plugin interfaces so inputs, transforms, and outputs can be implemented consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: ITransformPlugin: Type, InitializeAsync, ProcessAsync (returns Message or null)

userStories.title: Implement DSL lexer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a lexer that tokenizes .gflow files so the parser can process them.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokenize keywords: flow, from, route, on_error
Tokenize literals: strings (single/double quoted), numbers, booleans
Tokenize identifiers and dotted names (e.g., json.parse, decode.binary)

userStories.title: Implement DSL parser - basic structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a parser that converts tokens into a Flow AST for basic flow structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse from <type>("config") { key: value } input blocks
Return clear error messages with line/column on parse failure

userStories.title: Implement DSL parser - routing and error handling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the parser to handle routing blocks and error handling syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse | route { name: condition } routing blocks
Parse on_error: skip and on_error: route_to("name") error handling

userStories.title: Write parser unit tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need parser tests to ensure DSL parsing is correct and regressions are caught.
acceptanceCriteria: Test basic flow parsing (name, version extraction)
Test input block parsing with config
Test pipeline step parsing (transforms with args and blocks)
Test route block parsing with conditions
Test error cases return meaningful messages
All tests pass: dotnet test Gluey.Parser.Tests

userStories.title: Implement CLI validate command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to validate my .gflow file syntax without running it so I can catch errors early.
acceptanceCriteria: gluey validate <file.gflow> parses file and reports success/failure
On failure: print error message with line/column
Exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure

userStories.title: Implement PluginRegistry
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a plugin registry that creates plugin instances by type name so the runtime can instantiate them.
acceptanceCriteria: Register all built-in plugins at startup
Throws clear error if plugin type not found

userStories.title: Implement GlueyHostedService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an IHostedService that manages the workflow lifecycle so the daemon runs properly.
acceptanceCriteria: StartAsync: parses flow file, initializes plugins, starts WorkflowRunner
StopAsync: signals cancellation, waits for drain (5s timeout)

userStories.title: Implement WorkflowRunner
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a workflow executor that connects input → transforms → output so messages flow through the pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads messages from input plugin via IAsyncEnumerable
If transform returns null, message is dropped (filtered)
Sends final message to output plugin
Handles cancellation token for graceful shutdown

userStories.title: Implement CLI run command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to run my workflow as a daemon so it processes messages continuously.
acceptanceCriteria: gluey run <file.gflow> starts workflow as foreground daemon
Print startup message with workflow name and version
Print Shutting down... on termination signal

userStories.title: Implement HttpWebhookInput plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive HTTP POST requests as workflow input so I can integrate with webhooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Listens on configured port and path (e.g., /webhook on port 8080)
Accepts POST requests with JSON or binary body
Emits Message with payload as JsonDocument (or raw bytes in metadata)

userStories.title: Implement ConsoleOutput plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to output messages to console so I can debug workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Prints message payload as formatted JSON

userStories.title: Implement JsonParseTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to parse JSON payloads so I can work with structured data in transforms.
acceptanceCriteria: Replaces message payload with parsed JsonDocument
Supports on_error: skip (returns null on parse failure)

userStories.title: Create Demo 1 - Hello World
userStories.description: As a user, I want a simple example workflow to learn basic .gflow syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow runs and outputs JSON to console when curl sends POST

userStories.title: Implement FilterTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter messages by condition so I can drop irrelevant data.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluates condition expression against message payload
Returns message if condition is true, null if false
Supports nested field access: temperature, device.location.type

userStories.title: Implement TransformTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to transform message fields so I can reshape data for output.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates new payload from field mappings
Supports direct field copy: device_id: device_id
Supports nested field access: lat: device.location.lat

userStories.title: Create Demo 2 - Smart Sensor
userStories.description: As a user, I want an example showing filter and transform capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 02-smart-sensor.gflow: HTTP -> json.parse -> filter -> transform -> console
Transform includes temp_fahrenheit calculation and alert_level ternary

userStories.title: Implement BinaryDecodeTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to decode binary payloads so I can process compact IoT protocols.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads raw bytes from payload or specified field
Extracts fields using bytes(offset, length, type) format
Supports types: ascii/string, uint8, int16_be, int16_le, uint16_be, uint16_le
Supports types: int32_be, int32_le, uint32_be, uint32_le, float32_be, float32_le

userStories.title: Implement Base64DecodeTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to decode base64 strings so I can process encoded payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads base64 string from specified field
Passes to binary decode format if specified

userStories.title: Implement HexDecodeTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to decode hex strings so I can process hex-encoded payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads hex string from specified field (e.g., "41424344")
Passes to binary decode format if specified

userStories.title: Create Demo 3 - Binary Sensor
userStories.description: As a user, I want an example showing binary protocol decoding with endianness.
acceptanceCriteria: Binary format includes int16_be, uint16_le, uint8 fields
Transform converts raw values to meaningful data

userStories.title: Implement MqttSubscriberInput plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to subscribe to MQTT topics as workflow input so I can process IoT device messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Connects to MQTT broker at configured URL
Supports TLS connections via mqtts:// scheme or tls: true config
Emits Message with payload and topic in metadata

userStories.title: Implement MqttPublisherOutput plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to publish messages to MQTT topics so I can send data to brokers.
acceptanceCriteria: Connects to MQTT broker at configured URL
Supports TLS connections via mqtts:// scheme or tls: true config

userStories.title: Implement RouteTransform plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to route messages to different outputs based on conditions so I can handle different scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluates multiple route conditions in order
Sets route destination in message metadata
WorkflowRunner uses metadata to select output pipeline

userStories.title: Extend WorkflowRunner for routing
userStories.description: As a developer, I need WorkflowRunner to handle route destinations so conditional routing works.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect route metadata in message after RouteTransform
Execute appropriate output pipeline based on route name
Support multiple output pipelines (one per route)

userStories.title: Implement SqlOutput plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to insert messages into SQL databases so I can persist IoT data.
acceptanceCriteria: Connects to database via connection string
Auto-detects dialect from connection string prefix
Inserts into configured table with configured columns
On insert failure: logs error with details and continues (graceful)

userStories.title: Create Demo 4 - Industrial Pipeline
userStories.description: As a user, I want an example showing MQTT input, routing, and SQL output.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 04-industrial-pipeline.gflow: MQTT -> json.parse -> transform -> route -> MQTT/SQL outputs
Route critical alerts to MQTT, normal data to SQL

userStories.title: Create Demo 5 - Advanced Protocol
userStories.description: As a user, I want an advanced example showing binary header routing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 05-advanced-protocol.gflow: MQTT -> decode.binary (header) -> route -> decode.binary -> SQL
Route by msg_type field in binary header
Different decode formats per message type

userStories.title: Implement HttpOutput plugin
userStories.description: As a user, I want to send messages via HTTP POST so I can integrate with webhooks and APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: POSTs message payload as JSON to configured URL

userStories.title: Create Dockerfile
userStories.description: As a user, I want to run Gluey in Docker so I can deploy it in containers.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-stage build: SDK for build, runtime for final image

userStories.title: Write getting-started documentation
userStories.description: As a user, I want a quick start guide so I can get Gluey running in minutes.

userStories.title: Write DSL reference documentation
userStories.description: As a user, I want complete DSL documentation so I can write complex workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Input block syntax and config options

userStories.title: Write plugins documentation
userStories.description: As a user, I want plugin documentation so I know what inputs/transforms/outputs are available.
acceptanceCriteria: List of all 12 built-in plugins with descriptions

userStories.title: Create README.md
userStories.description: As a user, I want a project README so I understand what Gluey is and how to use it.
